comment: Headband firmware shipped with this app version (HARDWARE.md D23). In the prototype there is no real image: simulated = true makes the app run the update flow with SimulatedTransport.

notes.en: Steadier connection with some phone brands, more exact pad contact check, longer battery life at night.
notes.tr: Bazı telefon markalarıyla daha kararlı bağlantı, daha doğru ped temas ölçümü, gece daha uzun pil ömrü.
